201268.overview: A very rare Korean Columns clone for MSX1 by Screen Software. The game was also released as Super Columns.

205472.overview: The goal of the game is to escape from the slime center with various items. When you touch slimes your power decreases. Once you are out of power, the game is over.

206354.overview: Stevedore works at the docks, loading and unloading ships in a small coastal town. He is in love with the beautiful lighthouse keeper. Today is the annual summer party, and Stevedore is hurrying up to finish the job and go to the party with her. Suddenly… the floor cracks under his feet… Help Stevedore find the keys to get out of the abandoned warehouse. The lighthouse keeper is waiting for him at the lighthouse. Or isn't she? What other adventures might happen!? Good luck, Stevedore!

206385.overview: Explore the depths of the ocean with this completely remastered official conversion from the Mojon Twins classic. Search for the four artifacts and oxygen bubbles!

213387.overview:
Johnny goes back to the jungle in this remake of his very first adventure. Wild rivers, savage canibals, poisonous snakes, dark shrines and coffe, lots of coffe... a tasty one!

All the spirit from the classic Dinamic game but boosting to the limits the MSX system: new original music composed for the remake, a full graphic restyling, special effects using hardware sprites... Jhonny Jones hits stronger as never before!

218326.overview:
Two years ago, Spanish MSX developer Imanok released its title SHMUP! Kai; a heavily souped up re-imagining of their MSXdev'13 entry which was simply named SHMUP! in its first incarnation. All in the spirit of Christmas, Imanok has decided to donate the game to the scene to enjoy for free!

On the surface, it's a quite familiar looking vertically scrolling shooter, but on closer inspection there's a twist. The player will control not one, but two space fighters simultaneously. The gist of this is to strategically change their formation in accordance with when the current situation calls for it, to most effectively fend off the various different waves of enemies, as well as to avoid their counter attacks. However, your adversaries will put up quite a fight! Fortunately, there's a powerful trump card to aid the player - if they collect enough "Fusion Capsules", the two ships will temporarily merge into the mighty "G-Lasher", which employs firepower that tears through enemy lines with destructive ease.

SHMUP! Kai packs addictive gameplay, intimidating boss battles, thematically diverse stage backdrops, colorful graphics and a varied soundtrack. The game will run on any MSX1 or higher with at least 16Kb RAM. It already scrolls quite smoothly on any MSX model, but when played on MSX2 or higher, the graphics will be enhanced altogether. SHMUP! Kai can be downloaded from their official site or from our Download Database.

418333.overview: Unexpectedly, humans leave the mining planet, abandoning hundreds of robots to their fate under the sole tutelage of an artificial intelligence called I.S.A.C. The extractions of ETHER (a valuable substance unique in the galaxy) are beginning to affect the circuitry and positronic minds of some of the robots. … 100 Years Later …

418500.overview: You're Carlitos, the usual school boy who still has to hear the recommendations of his mother. Everything was going fine until someday you left your home and found a deserted street, but almost instantly you heard the sound of a grenade exploding, and some bad guys with a shotgun. You think of it as a nightmare, but then a bullet almost hits you. Just then you find a pistol in your bag, if these dudes are real, why shouldn't it be real too? Solo is another of the Opera games designed to be used with the Gun Stick, quite similar on its development to Opera's Trigger. Also, in spite of this game's solitary name, there will be the option to play a 2 players cooperative mode.

422335.overview: Shyre is a puzzle exploration game. You play as M011-Y, a member of the Space Archeology Corps stranded in the ruins of planet Shyre trying to get back to their spaceship.

423013.overview:
You are a Magic Knight, the hero of Finders Keepers. Your tutor Gimbal the Wizard has been trying out some very old spells to make his rice pudding taste nicer, unfortunately the scribes who translated the spells from very ancient English to slightly ancient English made some mistakes with the wording and Gimbal is in trouble.

The spell sent Gimbal to the mythical castle of Karn and dragged seven other people with him. As gimbal becomes trapped he projects a last faint message back to you across the time stream. I've taught you enough to rescue us all. Magic Knight, you are our only hope!!

423056.overview:
In the year 3122, humankind has conquered space and has taken their favourite pets with them: Cats.

Did you know that the favourite toys of cats in space are flying saucers? Even better, chasing mice while flying around! They are the only ones that can go into the narrow spaces and capture the SpaceRats, an evolved species that keeps annoying the crew of the spaceships.

It may not be easy, but cats are provided with expert training on the SpaceCat facility. Every kitty deserves a chance to pilot a spaceship.

Do you have what it takes to drive your Spaceship along the SpaceCat training deck?

Because the world will be a better place with more cats in flying saucers.

SpaceCat for MSX combines gameplay aspects of lander and platform games and it's a demake of the original SpaceCat game for Android published in 2011.

423091.overview: Stratos it's an arcade / maze (like Boulder Dash) game that joins action and strategy. The objective is to obtain all the diamonds in each labyrinth and to leave it in a limited time.

423093.overview:
A vertical shoot'em up (a bit bullet hell) with strategy involved during combat.

There are three different alien races to defeat, each one from a different planet. You can choose the stage before starting to play.

The game will have you auto-firing by default, but we can switch from wide shot, narrow shot or stop shooting. “Stop shooting”? Yes! In this position an energy bar will be filled and once full, hitting space bar will equip us with a force field that provides protection against enemy bullets. Also, there is a second energy bar just below the one mentioned before that gets filled when bullets pass by very close. Once that one’s full, the electromagnetic pulse is available, which alters the direction of incoming enemy projectiles. You also can use bombs that kill all the enemies on the screen.

423103.overview:
I'm Flash, the fastest cat in the city. I've spent the day wandering around with my friends, looking for some food and having fun... but I've suddenly remembered I have a date with Iris, the cutest kitty at downtown!!
I'm already late and I have a long way to go... I'll show you why they call me Flash!!

In this game you have to run and jump between the buildings, avoiding the obstacles you may find on your way, until you reach the house where Iris lives.

423202.overview:
Your mission is to get all the diamonds you can find around 24 different game zones.

For that, you have some little ship that can move over the blue walls of the game area. There's also some red walls that you can't move over. The diamonds are all around the game area. There's a limited number of them in every stage, and you can see the number of diamonds left at the upper right part of the screen. When you get a diamond, a new one will appear randomly. When you get them all, you can acces next area.

424689.overview: The main character, Ken, is a martial arts master who has practiced all of the world's famous martial arts. However, his position is always in jeopardy. The representatives of five countries - the United Kingdom, the United States, Japan, China, and Hong Kong - have issued a challenge to Ken, and Ken must face off against them in a fateful confrontation. It's up to you to master Ken's special moves, "Dragon Twister" and "Surge Fist," and defeat the five challengers.

471995.overview: The game Space Bash: Contact!! is an action platformer beat’em up inspired by the Jaleco arcade Rod Land. One screen, platforms, ladders, items, and a sh!t load of alien scum.

474537.overview: A homebrew port of Super Mario World to the Microsoft MSX.

481997.overview: A vertical-scrolling action shooter that stands out from other titles in the genre: you pilot two ships simultaneously, in a cooperative mode. If you collect enough fusion capsules—dropped by defeated drones—the two ships will merge into a super-fighter
